Minesweeper
Engine
The classic game rebuilt to hold a million cells without slowing down.
  • QuadTree spatial partitioning, applied recursively
  • Bit-packed cell state for memory density
  • Deterministic from a shared seed
  • No dependencies, rendered on canvas
